name: Power-Assisted Bicycle
description: An e-bike: a bicycle with a handlebar, pedals and no more than three wheels, and an electric motor of 500 W or less that gives no power above 32 km/h, pedal-assist or throttle.

restrictions.rule: Handlebar steering, pedals, no more than three wheels, and can be propelled by muscle power on the pedals
restrictions.citation: The Highway Traffic Act, C.C.S.M. c. H60, s. 1(1)

restrictions.rule: An electric motor and no other kind, rated 500 W or less continuous at its shaft, that gives no power when the bike is going over 32 km/h
restrictions.citation: The Highway Traffic Act, C.C.S.M. c. H60, s. 1(1)

restrictions.rule: Pedal-assist power stops as soon as the rider stops pedalling; throttle power stops as soon as the rider brakes
restrictions.citation: The Highway Traffic Act, C.C.S.M. c. H60, s. 1(1)

restrictions.rule: Needs a driver-operated motor on/off switch, separate from any throttle, or a mechanism that keeps the motor from engaging below 3 km/h
restrictions.citation: The Highway Traffic Act, C.C.S.M. c. H60, s. 1(1)

restrictions.rule: Riders must be 14 or older on a highway or bicycle facility, and an owner may not let anyone younger ride it
restrictions.citation: The Highway Traffic Act, C.C.S.M. c. H60, s. 145(2) and (3)

restrictions.rule: Every rider and passenger must wear a properly fitted and fastened helmet
restrictions.citation: The Highway Traffic Act, C.C.S.M. c. H60, s. 145(4)

restrictions.rule: Has a motor vehicle driver's rights and duties: rides close to the right-hand curb, single file, and may use the shoulder or a lane set aside for power-assisted bicycles
restrictions.citation: The Highway Traffic Act, C.C.S.M. c. H60, s. 145(1) and (6); Highway Traffic (General) Regulation, M.R. 119/2014, s. 2(1)
The Highway Traffic Act, C.C.S.M. c. H60, s. 193(1)

restrictions.rule: Carries no more people than it was built for, except a child under six in a belted infant seat behind the rider, with a rider 16 or older
restrictions.citation: The Highway Traffic Act, C.C.S.M. c. H60, s. 147(1) and (2)

restrictions.rule: Needs a white headlamp and a red or amber rear lamp or reflector when lights are required
restrictions.citation: The Highway Traffic Act, C.C.S.M. c. H60, s. 149(1) and (3)

restrictions.rule: Not a motor vehicle: no driver's licence, registration or insurance
restrictions.citation: The Highway Traffic Act, C.C.S.M. c. H60, ss. 1(1) and 24(1); The Drivers and Vehicles Act, C.C.S.M. c. D104, s. 34

restrictions.rule: Bill 43, given Royal Assent on June 1, 2026, is not yet in force and awaits proclamation: once it is, the e-bike becomes a personal electric vehicle alongside e-scooters, its helmet must meet the regulations' standards, and it may be ridden on a sidewalk marked to allow it
restrictions.citation: The Highway Traffic Amendment and Drivers and Vehicles Amendment Act, Bill 43, 2026 (Manitoba), ss. 2, 11(8) and 13
